I need to plan my meals one month at a time. I'd like to automate most of the process.

Following is an example of the process, done manually, where...

The month is covered by three types of menu options; "cook", "leftovers" and "whatever". On cook days I can cook a meal for two days or three days. The recipe will determine which. The user determines which recipe to use on which days with a drag and drop type of UI. As this happens, the system will calculate a running total of quantity needed for a specfic ingredient and this will ultimate result in a shopping list for the month.
